footer.tagline: A desktop Git client that keeps the graph, your pull and merge requests, CI, issues, releases, terminals, AI runs, .http requests and a file editor in the same window.
footer.bottom: Free, source-available, no account, no telemetry.
ld.description: Desktop Git client for GitHub and GitLab with a canvas commit graph, pull and merge requests, CI pipelines, issues, releases, terminals, AI CLI runs in isolated worktrees, an in-repo .http request workspace and a file editor. macOS, Linux and Windows. Built on Tauri, not Electron. No account and no telemetry.
hero.microcta: If it saves you a tab, a ★ on the repo is how other people find it.
themes.preview_alt: The in-app file editor rendered in the selected theme
audience.fit_title: You'll probably like it if you
install.meta_macos: Drag it to /Applications, then run that command once to clear Gatekeeper's quarantine flag. It goes away when the app is signed.
install.meta_linux: Mark it executable and run it. Needs libwebkit2gtk-4.1. No .deb or .rpm right now — build from source if you need one.
install.meta_windows: Needs the WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 already has. The .msi comes back once the app is signed.
